patch_description: Instead of stochastic hill-climbing with expensive full rescoring per candidate, this uses a fully differentiable objective: a temperature-annealed LogSumExp soft-minimum over all 286 triangle cross-products (scale-invariant, so no hull normalization needed during optimization). Gradients are computed analytically per-point and optimized with Adam. A seed sweep keeps the top-2 basins, and the remaining budget alternates short re-annealed Adam runs between them, as recommended. Final points are affine-rescaled so the convex hull has unit area. This explores the landscape far faster (vectorized gradients, no rejection loops) and concentrates refinement on the two best basins.
